event.text: Call 911 now. Swelling of your lips and tongue with throat tightness and hives soon after eating shrimp can block your airway quickly. If you have an epinephrine auto-injector, use it now and still call 911. Do not drive yourself, stay with someone, and tell the dispatcher your throat feels tight.
